amanda_sales: Morning — Heads up: GreenCrest (regional bank) just sent an RFI. They asked for a capability matrix + written responses and want a draft by EOD Wednesday. I uploaded their questionnaire here: https://drive.internal/greencrest_rfi.pdf :eyes:

aj_eng: I can take the technical sections (POC approach, deployment types, perf numbers). Need expected workload: seq length, tokens per request, and target p95 latency.

patrick_pricing: I'll draft a pricing band. Quick Q: do we have a standard enterprise discount for reserved 500M tokens/mo? If they commit annual, we usually do tiered.

amanda_sales: They indicated 500M tokens/month as baseline and want options for Dedicated and Private. They also asked about burst capacity and canary rollouts.

nisha_security: I'll own the security questionnaire bits (SOC2, encryption, KMS, data residency, DSARs). Can someone add the exact KMS integrations list and whether we support HSM?

aj_eng: Short answers for matrix I can confirm now. Private (VPC/on-prem): Yes — we have a private control plane + on-prem package. Dedicated: Yes. Hosted API with regional isolation: Yes (US/EU regions).

aj_eng: POC plan suggestion: 2-week functional POC (chat + inference), then 2-week scale test on Dedicated pool. Need GreenCrest to provide sample prompts + auth test users. We'll provide a test workload harness and perf dashboard.

patrick_pricing: Pricing notes for RFI: list price for hosted gen is $0.003/token (example) — for 500M we propose a committed rate with 20-35% discount depending on term + dedicated reservation fee for Dedicated pools (monthly). I'll put ranges not hard quotes.

nisha_security: For the questionnaire: SOC2 Type II: we completed controls mapping in 2024-06; ISO27001 roadmap in progress. Encryption: customer data encrypted at rest (AES-256) and in transit (TLS1.2+). KMS: We support customer-managed keys (AWS KMS, GCP KMS, Azure Key Vault) and have an HSM-compatible option for Private deployments.

kelly_cust_success: I'll prepare a short customer success plan for the POC: success criteria, support channels, and onboarding checklist. Also can coordinate the NDAs and DPA signatures.

amanda_sales: They also asked about SSO/SAML and SCIM provisioning, SCIM group sync. Can we confirm support and any vendor caveats?

aj_eng: SSO: Yes — SAML 2.0 supported, IdP-initiated and SP-initiated flows tested. SCIM: yes for user + group provisioning. Caveat: for on-prem deployments, SCIM requires a reachability configuration (we'll provide a connector).

nisha_security: Data residency: we can deploy in EU/US regions. For strict residency (no cross-border backups) we can do Private with region-isolated storage; will need legal approval on contract side for certain regulated data.

amanda_sales: GreenCrest also sent a detailed RFP capability matrix. I started a short answers sheet in the drive: https://drive.internal/greencrest_answers_v1.xlsx — please add your rows under your initials.

aj_eng: Adding notes. Quick paste for the matrix (will refine):
```
Capability | Redwood support | Short note
SSO (SAML) | Yes | SAML 2.0, SCIM provisioning, SSO + SCIM tested with Okta
Private VPC/on-prem | Yes | Private control plane available; on-prem package for air-gapped envs
Dedicated (reserved) | Yes | Dedicated GPU pools, autoscaling + burst options + SLA
SOC2 Type II | Partial | Controls mapped; audit report available on request (via AICPA bridge)
Encryption | Yes | TLS1.2+ in transit, AES-256 at rest, CMEK via KMS/HSM
Data residency | Yes | Region-specific deployments; strict residency via Private
Streaming | Yes | Token streaming + chunked responses supported
Latency SLA | Optional | SLA for Dedicated; hosted has latency profiles by model
Traffic isolation | Yes | Tenant isolation for Dedicated and Private

```

patrick_pricing: I'll add pricing lines into the spreadsheet. Amanda — do you want me to include a sample committed pricing worksheet?

amanda_sales: Yes please, include a committed pricing worksheet with 12/24 month options and a Dedicated reservation add-on.

nisha_security: Request: can someone attach the controls mapping doc and our SOC2 statement (redacted) to the drive? I have the current controls spreadsheet but not the final statement.

kelly_cust_success: I have the SOC2 summary in our secure drive; will link it. Also I'll upload the standard DPA template and POC runbook.

rfi-bot: New RFI assigned: GreenCrest_RFI_1742007654 — owner: amanda_sales. Deadline: 2024-06-12 17:00 UTC.

amanda_sales: Thanks @rfi-bot. Next steps: aj — can you drop a 1-page POC summary and perf targets by EOD today? patrick — pricing worksheet draft by tomorrow morning. nisha — security answers + attachments by EOD Tuesday. Kelly — POC runbook + DPA link. I'll assemble the RFI and send back to GreenCrest. :thumbsup:

aj_eng: Will do. I'm blocked on one item: does GreenCrest need PCI-level processing? They mentioned payments in scope. If yes, we need to surface limitations on card processing and maybe recommend tokenization flow.

amanda_sales: Good catch — GreenCrest: payments product doing card tokenization, so they need PCI-safe integration. I'll confirm whether tokenization is handled upstream.

patrick_pricing: One more blocker: any uplift for HSM-backed CMEK on Private? That impacts margin. odp: yes, typically a fixed surcharge + monthly HSM fee. I'll note that in the worksheet.

nisha_security: If payments/card data is in scope, add a note: we don't recommend routing raw PAN through hosted endpoints unless customer controls tokenization and scope is covered in DPA. For Private deploy, we can isolate and support compliance tighter.

amanda_sales: Great — thanks all. I'm going to compile an initial draft this afternoon and will ping the channel when it's ready for review. If anyone wants to hop on a 15m review at 3pm, react with :raised_hand:.

aj_eng: :raised_hand:

patrick_pricing: :+1:

kelly_cust_success: :raised_hand:

nisha_security: :eyes:

amanda_sales: Thanks — closing out for now. I'll post the assembled RFI here once done.
